[Unit]
Description=Remount Root and Kernel File Systems
Documentation=man:systemd-remount-fs.service(8)
Documentation=https://systemd.io/API_FILE_SYSTEMS

DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-fsck-root.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target local-fs.target
Wants=local-fs-pre.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target
Before=shutdown.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-remount-fs

Wants=dev-mqueue.mount systemd-update-done.service kmod-static-nodes.service systemd-binfmt.service systemd-pcrmachine.service sys-fs-fuse-connections.mount systemd-hibernate-clear.service systemd-journal-flush.service systemd-machine-id-commit.service plymouth-read-write.service sys-kernel-config.mount dev-hugepages.mount keyboard-setup.service sys-kernel-tracing.mount systemd-udevd.service systemd-tmpfiles-setup-dev.service ldconfig.service systemd-timesyncd.service imports.target proc-sys-fs-binfmt_misc.automount swap.target systemd-random-seed.service systemd-pcrnvdone.service systemd-modules-load.service systemd-tpm2-setup.service haveged.service systemd-pcrphase.service local-fs.target systemd-journald.service systemd-ask-password-console.path plymouth-start.service systemd-sysusers.service systemd-hwdb-update.service systemd-firstboot.service systemd-udev-trigger.service systemd-tmpfiles-setup.service systemd-tpm2-setup-early.service systemd-pstore.service systemd-pcrproduct.service systemd-tmpfiles-setup-dev-early.service systemd-journal-catalog-update.service systemd-pcrphase-sysinit.service systemd-sysctl.service sys-kernel-debug.mount
ActiveState=active
SubState=active
FragmentPath=/usr/lib/systemd/system/sysinit.target
DropInPaths=
ConditionResult=yes

Requires=
Wants=tmp.mount
ActiveState=active
SubState=active
FragmentPath=/usr/lib/systemd/system/local-fs.target
DropInPaths=
ConditionResult=yes

Requires=system.slice
Wants=local-fs-pre.target
ActiveState=inactive
SubState=dead
FragmentPath=/usr/lib/systemd/system/systemd-remount-fs.service
DropInPaths=
